name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Vertically stacked collapsible disclosure panels built on reka-ui, with single or multiple open items.
docs: Set type to single (default) or multiple and bind with v-model. collapsible defaults to true so the active single item can be closed again. Content height animates via --reka-accordion-content-height under motion-safe.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AccordionRoot } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AccordionProps = {
  /** Whether one item or several items can stay open at once. */
  type?: 'single' | 'multiple'
  /** Allows closing the active item when `type` is `"single"`. */
  collapsible?: boolean
  defaultValue?: string | string[]
  disabled?: boolean
  unmountOnHide?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<AccordionProps>(), {
  type: undefined,
  collapsible: true,
  defaultValue: undefined,
  disabled: false,
  unmountOnHide: true,
})

const model = defineModel<string | string[]>()
const resolvedType = computed<'single' | 'multiple'>(
  () => props.type ?? (Array.isArray(model.value ?? props.defaultValue) ? 'multiple' : 'single'),
)

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionRoot
    v-model="model"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :type="resolvedType"
    :collapsible="collapsible"
    :default-value="defaultValue"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :unmount-on-hide="unmountOnHide"
    :class="cn('w-full', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </AccordionRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AccordionItem } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AccordionItemProps = {
  value: string
  disabled?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AccordionItemProps>(), {
  disabled: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionItem
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :value="value"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :class="cn('border-b border-line last:border-b-0', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </AccordionItem>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs, useId } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AccordionHeader, AccordionTrigger, injectCollapsibleRootContext } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const collapsibleContext = injectCollapsibleRootContext(null)
const fallbackContentId = `p0seid0n-accordion-content-${useId()}`
if (collapsibleContext && !collapsibleContext.contentId) {
  collapsibleContext.contentId = fallbackContentId
}

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionHeader class="m-0 flex">
    <AccordionTrigger
      v-bind="forwarded"
      :class="
        cn(
          'group flex flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-[6px] py-4 text-left text-[15px] font-medium text-ink',
          'outline-none hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink',
          'disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-55',
          attrs.class as ClassValue,
        )
      "
    >
      <slot />
      <slot name="icon">
        <svg
          class="size-4 shrink-0 text-ink-muted transition-[rotate,color] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-normal)] ease-out-expo group-hover:text-ink group-data-[state=open]:rotate-180 motion-reduce:transition-none"
          viewBox="0 0 16 16"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="1.75"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          stroke-linejoin="round"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4" />
        </svg>
      </slot>
    </AccordionTrigger>
  </AccordionHeader>
</template>

export { default as Accordion } from './Accordion.vue'
export { default as AccordionItem } from './AccordionItem.vue'
export { default as AccordionTrigger } from './AccordionTrigger.vue'
export { default as AccordionContent } from './AccordionContent.vue'

export type { AccordionProps } from './Accordion.vue'
export type { AccordionItemProps } from './AccordionItem.vue'
